standard.coverage: All covered employers, aged 16 and over. The highest STATE minimum wage in the country for 2026.

tipped.note: This state allows NO tip credit: the full state minimum wage must be paid in cash before any tips. RCW 49.46.020 -- Washington has never allowed a tip credit, and neither do any of its eight local ordinances.

variants.label: Employees aged 14 and 15
variants.test: 85% of the state minimum wage -- 85% of $17.13 = $14.5605, published as $14.56.

knownGaps: Eight Washington cities and counties set higher local rates, several with employer-size tiers and one with a MID-YEAR step -- see local/WA-local-2026.json.
